collection.title: Mercedes-Benz GLA Class 2015 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz GLA Class SUV 2015 - 2020 (156) requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this GLA Class which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below. PLEASE NOTE - THE VF923 IS A SPECIAL ORDER PART - PLEASE ALLOW AN EXTRA 2-3 WORKING DAYS.
